title: Global epistemic-core interpretive-lens set
description: Schema for `config/ensemble-lenses/lenses.yaml` — the 5 fixed reasoning-style interpretive lenses shared by every modality (mechanistic, systems, translational, skeptical, exploratory), loaded by `EnsembleRosterProvider::load_epistemic_core`. Distinct from the per-modality `config/ensemble-rosters/<modality>.yaml` interpretive_lenses block (per-modality subfield lenses).

schema_version.description: Schema-layout version for this epistemic-core lens set. Bump on breaking layout changes.

persona_ref.description: Filename of the persona markdown file under `config/ensemble-lenses/personas/`.

model_tier.description: Model-tier assignment for this lens's contextualization pass.
